name: TG Forward Bot
description: A Telegram auto-forward bot (Bot API-based) with topic support, per-user destination setup, and resumable forwarding jobs.

OWNER_ID.description: Your personal Telegram numeric user ID (get from @userinfobot). The bot's admin.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (e.g. from MongoDB Atlas free tier).

MONGO_DB_NAME.description: Name of the MongoDB database to use.

DEFAULT_DELAY_SECONDS.description: Default delay (in seconds) between forwarded messages.
